info.name: FHIR API - test collection
info.description: Tests for the FHIR R4 API (http://localhost:5100/fhir/r4), using the Mock EHR test data (MockEhr.Api/Data/TestData). Reset the Mock EHR first (POST http://localhost:5090/api/admin/reset) so the expected totals match. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner; folders 2, 15 and 16 save ids in collection variables, so run their requests in order.

item.name: 0. Metadata
item.description: CapabilityStatement: what this FHIR server supports. Anyone may call it.

request.description: Returns the CapabilityStatement of the server (FHIR R4 4.0.1).

item.name: 1. Patient
item.description: Read a patient by id, or search with _id (one id or several, comma separated = OR).

request.description: Robert Hayes, the main test patient.

exec: pm.test("Bundle of type searchset", function () { pm.expect(body.resourceType).to.eql("Bundle"); pm.expect(body.type).to.eql("searchset"); });

pm.test("every match is a Patient", function () { (body.entry || []).filter(function (e) { return !e.search || e.search.mode === "match"; }).forEach(function (e) { pm.expect(e.resource.resourceType).to.eql("Patient"); }); });
pm.test("Bundle of type searchset", function () { pm.expect(body.resourceType).to.eql("Bundle"); pm.expect(body.type).to.eql("searchset"); });

pm.test("every match is a Patient", function () { (body.entry || []).filter(function (e) { return !e.search || e.search.mode === "match"; }).forEach(function (e) { pm.expect(e.resource.resourceType).to.eql("Patient"); }); });

exec: pm.test("data is a Base64 PDF", function () { pm.expect(body.data.substring(0, 7)).to.eql("JVBERi0"); });
